---
title: "Movie"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
basics <- read_tsv(
  "title.basics.tsv.gz",
  na = "\\N",
  col_types = cols_only(  # Explicitly select columns
    tconst = col_character(),
    titleType = col_character(),
    primaryTitle = col_character(),
    originalTitle = col_character(),
    isAdult = col_integer(),
    startYear = col_character(),
    endYear = col_character(),
    runtimeMinutes = col_character(),
    genres = col_character()
  )
) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(c(startYear, endYear, runtimeMinutes), ~ na_if(., "\\N")),
    across(c(startYear, endYear, runtimeMinutes), as.numeric),
    isAdult = as.logical(isAdult)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(tconst))  # Remove any completely invalid rows

glimpse(basics)
```
